shared_schema.input: Strict JSON object: schema_version=1, synthetic=true, as_of=timezone-aware ISO timestamp, consent=boolean, persona={id:persona-NNNN,synthetic_address:NOT A REAL ADDRESS}, items=list, events=list, limit=1..50.
shared_schema.item: id=item-NNNN; entity=citizen_service_request|benefits_application|policy_document; topic=housing|transport|family|environment; public_priority=integer 0..100; form={case_number:CASE-SYN-NNNN,summary:text} for requests/applications otherwise null; policy_text=text for policy documents otherwise null.
shared_schema.event: id=event-NNNN, item_id=known item-NNNN, action=browse|purchase, at=timezone-aware ISO timestamp no later than as_of.
shared_schema.output: Success: status, schema_version, synthetic, mode, reason, recommendations with item_id/entity/label/score/explanation, audit. Errors: status=error and non-echoing plain-language message; exit 2.
shared_schema.validation: Single validate boundary; exact fields; strict booleans and bounded integer values; unique IDs and JSON keys; finite JSON numbers; catalog/event bounds; synthetic-only persona/address/case rules; basic contact/identity-number screening. Raw free text and persona identifiers never appear in results.

cross_stage_handoffs: Validated catalog and timestamped events feed one deterministic discovery ranking function; no other stages.

behavior.recency: Each browse contributes 1 and purchase contributes 2, multiplied by 2^(-age_days/30). Topic interest is topic weight divided by max(1,total weight), so old sparse history fades.
behavior.ranking: With usable consented history: 0.2 * public_priority/100 + 0.8 * topic_interest. Scores rounded to 10 decimals; ties resolved by ascending item ID. Input is not mutated.
behavior.cold_start: No consent or total effective history below 1e-9: rank only by public priority. Empty catalog returns an empty list. All events are validated even without consent, but then ignored.
behavior.public_sector: Synthetic purchase is a generic discovery engagement signal, not a payment or benefits award. Rank does not decide eligibility, entitlement, service access or case outcome.
behavior.reviewability: Per-result numerical contributions, public algorithm parameters, ranking time, tie rule and short plain-language explanations support demonstrative open-records review without exposing citizen data.

included: Synthetic government form JSON and invented policy text
Fabricated persona identifier, invented case numbers and non-traceable address placeholder
Recency-weighted personalized discovery and cold start
CLI errors and deterministic unittest fixtures
excluded: Production PII detection or redaction guarantees
Live networks, providers and LLM calls

coverage: CLI success, file errors, malformed JSON and invalid input
